name: opencode-claude-bridge
description: OpenCode ↔ Claude bridge with a multi-account pool. Source-installed fork of dotCipher/opencode-claude-bridge; the npm package of that name is upstream.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-info.mjs
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build/test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir build/test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.test:native: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build/test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --outDir build/test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs --native

author: dotCipher
